title: bug: Windows restart retry forgets a surviving orphan after its supervisor dies
description:
RF04 step-5 reproduction on checkpoint 613902b: with null daemon info, first restart kills own supervisor and refuses for a live survivor or incomplete child identity; the second restart returns null with that child still alive, in LEGACY and PROTECTED.
Cause: ownSupervisor drops the dead root and stopOldTree discards its call-local OldTree; retry sees no roots. Scratch FR1-FR4 all assertion-failed, 0 errors, at 2026-10-30T12:04:55Z; patch and retry-red.{log,json,xml} in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/rf04-worker-c2da129d/.
Needs architect scope disposition/retained-capture retry design; no source edit made. Source prerequisites are already landed (7e996666 + 613902b); no dependsOn RF04 to avoid a cycle if RF04 blocks on this safety defect.
definitionOfDone: Both profiles keep refusing a repeated restart while an old captured descendant survives or discovery remains incomplete; FR1-FR4 become permanent regression tests and a successful verified cleanup can recover.

Retry state retains captured process identities/death cutoffs, grants no authority over pid reusers or unidentified processes, and cannot be bypassed by daemon.json disappearance, own-reference replacement, or ensureDaemonRunning.
Windows verification runs under jetbrains-gradle lease; non-Windows behavior and existing RF04/RF03 tests stay green.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits or agent Git writes; wrappers own landing.
Coordinate scope with RF04 task-de91373a5ed84530b29fc4cfbcee974a before shared source edits. Do not overlap edits to MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt or its test.
Nothing persisted; existing fixed refusals, installed stop, signal authority and bounded waits remain.
